message.content:
The first device is a gravity-threading coil, which untangles the local gravitational field by pulling tiny threads of spacetime out of the room.
 Next, the light-bend alloy panel is installed; it refracts photons into a visible lattice of color that hangs in midair without any mirror.
  Then a time-coil motor is switched on, folding the next hour of time into a pocket where the room's clocks tick backward at one second per hour.
   Finally, the sound-warming spring is tuned: it converts the room's echoes into a warm blanket that the air itself holds, letting the walls whisper back in the color of old sunlight.
